verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a session supervisor for "background workers and agent runtimes that must outlive an SDK call". It also has event-reactive pieces: auto_resume lets inbound access wake a paused sandbox, and Sandbox Functions expose HTTP handlers. Together these let agent work run in the background, but the product does not document defining automations itself. Recurring runs depend on external tools such as GitHub Actions, which earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native automation or trigger configuration, recurring scheduling (cron) within the product, and hands-on or independent corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
